name: Newfie's Realistic Sailing
description: Adds detailed wind, Beaufort sea states, gusts and point-of-sail physics to sailing, with wear and repair, seasonal winds, a logbook, squalls, temporal storms at sea, anchoring, fog banks, rogue waves, rougher seas, capsizing, swamping, recovery balloons, craftable weather glass, wind vane, anchor and logbook items, and storm warnings, and client-side bobbing hulls and spray in rough seas.
